label: Atlassian Marketplace
terms_note: Automation of versions/reporting allowed with a partner Atlassian account + API token (Basic auth); NEW listing is UI-only with 5-10 business-day human approval; Marketplace Partner Agreement must be accepted (acceptedAgreements field); Atlassian is MoR (75-85% share); token traffic under burst rate limits (no published number).

sdks: https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/cli-reference/register/ (Forge CLI: forge deploy / forge register; no listing command)

auth: 1. Tenant has a Marketplace **partner account** (marketplace.atlassian.com/manage → "Manage vendor account"); paid apps need bank
2. Tenant creates an Atlassian **API token** at id.atlassian.com (Security → API tokens); tokens have a set expiry chosen at creation.
3. Every call: HTTP Basic — username = Atlassian account e-mail, password = the API token. No OAuth scopes.

endpoints.purpose: name, description, branding, security/privacy info, bank details; 5–10 business-day review
returns artifact details referenced by the version call

endpoints.call: v3 reporting group (sales / transactions / licenses / churn / conversion / renewal)
endpoints.purpose: as exposed by the community MCP server's 95 tools

endpoints.call: set on the version through Manage listings / `supportedPaymentModel`; Atlassian is merchant of record

reference.limits: No number published for the Marketplace API. Atlassian applies **burst rate limits to API-token traffic** and since 2025-03-13 sends beta quota headers; back off on 429 with the `Retry-After` header. - Automation allowed for partners on their own listings; the NEW-listing form and the Marketplace Partner Agreement are human steps. - Every new app is reviewed against the app-approval guidelines (security, privacy, Forge/Connect requirements); new versions of an already-approved app do NOT need approval ("new versions don't require approval"). - Atlassian collects payment (75–85 % partner share
mcp_sdk: Community MCP: https://github.com/rustem-shiriiazdanov/atlassian-marketplace-mcp (MIT; wraps v3 reporting + v1 promotions with
Official Atlassian MCP (https://github.com/atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server) covers Jira / Confluence / Bitbucket — NOT the Marketplace.
Forge CLI (`forge deploy`, `forge register`) deploys the app; it has **no** Marketplace-listing command.

fields.name: email
fields.help: Email of the Atlassian account that belongs to the Marketplace partner (vendor) with reporting access; Basic auth username (securitySchemes mpac_authed http basic in https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/rest/v2/ swagger.v3.json).

fields.name: api_token
fields.help: Atlassian API token of that account (https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens), used as the Basic auth password.

config_fields.name: vendor_id
config_fields.help: Numeric Marketplace partner (vendor) id, shown in the Marketplace partner portal URL (/manage/vendors/{vendorId}).

adapter.terms: Marketplace reporting APIs are for the partner's own data; amounts are reported in USD.

me.note: There is no 'current user' resource: the probe reads one sales transaction of config vendor_id ('This resource requires authentication'), which proves the credentials have reporting access to that partner.

list_products.note: Get apps (by vendor) for config vendor_id, private listings included (includePrivate=true with the partner's credentials). `id` is the app key; status is the listing status (e.g. public, private, rejected). Pricing is not part of the app record; `status` input is not a filter and is not sent.

get_product.note: Get app by app key (`product_id` = addonKey): name, summary, tagLine, status, lastModified, marketing and _embedded details under raw; no price.

list_sales.note: Get transactions (newest first) for config vendor_id, filtered by `product_id` (addon key) and `since` (startDate, YYYY-MM-DD only). `amount` is purchasePrice ('The sale price in USD'); vendorAmount (your share), saleType (new, renewal, upgrade, refund), licenseType and hosting are under raw.purchaseDetails. Refund transactions appear here too (saleType refund, negative amounts).

list_refunds.note: Get transactions with saleType=refund since `since` (YYYY-MM-DD). amount is the (negative) USD purchasePrice; refundReason under purchaseDetails; sale_id is the original transaction when Atlassian reports originalTransactionDetails.

not_offered.create_product: App listings are created through the Marketplace partner portal / app submission flow, not a create call in the REST API v2 reporting / apps groups (https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/rest/v2/).
not_offered.update_price: Paid-via-Atlassian app prices are set per tier in the partner portal; the Apps API exposes no pricing write (https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/rest/v2/api-group-apps/).
not_offered.get_sales_stats: Aggregated sales (GET /vendors/{vendorId}/reporting/sales/transactions/{metric}) return per-period series ({total: {name, series[]}, addons[]}) by country / hosting / tier / type, not a single revenue total the vocabulary can report (https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/rest/v2/api-group-reporting/).
not_offered.refund: Refunds are processed by Atlassian (customer requests to Atlassian); the REST API only reports refund transactions (https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/rest/v2/api-group-reporting/).

evidence: probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
